newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLOs nosedive in pre-holiday profit-taking panic.
newsitem.headline: OLOs nosedive in pre-holiday profit-taking panic.

text.p: Linear bond futures nosedived with Bunds in late Friday trade as a bout of panicky profit-taking wiped out all the gains made this week.
Dealers were at a loss to explain what was happening, as U.S. T-bond futures held up relatively well.

"It is a technical sell-off," one dealer said, adding that with the three-day weekend ahead of them, dealers wanted to avoid having long positions open in an increasingly nervous market. On Monday the market is closed.
By 1445 GMT, fifteen minutes before the close, OLO futures stood 43 bp lower at 121.35. They had risen 21 in early trade.
